inclusion_rule: Include studies that infer a paralinguistic property of the speaker or utterance (affect or emotion, speaker identity, speaking mode, prosody, intonation or pitch) from a non-acoustic speech-production signal recorded while speaking (EMG, EMA, ultrasound, real-time MRI, electropalatography, strain sensors, ECoG or intracortical recordings). Boundary: acoustic-only and face-video audiovisual emotion recognition are excluded; facial EMG or EEG emotion recognition without speech production is excluded; F0 or prosody counts only when reported as an output; surveys are pattern matches only; versions of one study count once.
